notes.title: Patch Notes September 9
notes.notes:
Version Number: 23185

[h3][b]Major fix:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when placing buildings on missions with pre-placed Gun Turrets (“Guns Blazing” and “Stating the Blobb-vious”).
[/list]
[h3][b]Tweaks and fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Gun Turrets now properly target General Blobbius and all of his cronies.
[*] A small rework of the mission “Stating the Blobb-vious” improves visuals and gameplay.
[*] Artillery now properly targets high-ranking Brainioids in the mission “We’re in Big B Trouble”.
[*] Janitors now properly yell when hurt, or if their doom is imminent. Poor things.
[*] Small tutorial tweak in the mission "Guns Blazing" now properly highlights Chip's Overdrive ability.
[*] A few typos were corrected.
[*] The “IDKFA” achievement now works properly. If completed, reloading your save will trigger it.
[*] A mysterious sphere named “Alien Cat Spawner” was removed from the game. Or was it?
[/list]

notes.title: Known Issues with Steam Next Fest Demo & Upcoming Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Earthlings! 

Thanks so much to everyone who's played the Steam Next Fest demo so far! It's incredible to see you all enjoying the demo and of course, showing those pesky Brainioids who's boss. 

We wanted to give a quick update on Known Issues we've spotted (see below). We plan to go out with a patch tomorrow to fix the issues mentioned in the Levels section -- stay tuned for updates! 

[h2][b]Demo 0.9.20101 - Known Issues [/b] [/h2]

[b][h3]Co-op[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes accepting a Steam invitation through Steam's "Friend Invite" feature does not work the first time, then accepting a second invitation works correctly.
[/list]

[h3][b]Levels[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Toxic Pond Level (The 5th Challenge Level) - Watchtower's collider does not work and cannot be destroyed by Shooters. 
[*] Commanding Heights (PvP Map) - miners may get stuck and not mine one of the central Brainium crystals correctly.
[/list]
